24.notice: Three mirrors closed in a triangle reflect each other's images again and again, so strictly the number of images has no limit, and no option says so. MSTA's key gives (B), 12. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.

31.notice: Soil pH is usually tested with one part soil to two parts water (1:2, option A). MSTA's key gives (B), 2:1. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.
